purpose: Investigate the EHAM January arrival taxi-in tail increase using observed arrival labels, operational covariates and recording diagnostics. No departure-label attribution or new taxi-out model is implied.
population: All 2025 and January/July 2026 arrivals for monthly label summaries; detailed arrival features for EHAM, EDDF and LSZH. EHAM is the lead; EDDF/LSZH are weather-change comparisons identified in step 1, not randomized controls.
weather: Match the destination airport's latest preceding METAR to landing, with the existing 90-minute age limit. Keep strict snow SN/SG separate from PL/GS ice pellets/small hail. Add past-24h snow exposure from prior reports only; never join by the origin airport or use future weather.
traffic: Arrival and departure counts in the 30 minutes before landing, excluding simultaneous events. Use actual UTC months, mask the first 30 minutes of each source month if prior events are unavailable, and retain missingness.
adjustment: Transparent common-cell comparisons, first weather/traffic then runway, stand area, time of day and route/fleet groups. Define bins from 2025 only, use no arrival label to create groups, show coverage and sparse cells. Report observed and standardized tail rates only on the same supported target rows; unadjusted unsupported rows remain visible.
reference_checks: January year comparison is primary. July year comparison and EHAM's 2025 month-to-month rates are context. Full-year-2025 reference is a separately labelled sensitivity, never substituted silently for January.
recording_checks: block time close to schedule/ARVT clocks at exact and 60-second tolerances
repeated block timestamps on multiple arrivals
concentration by day, runway, airline, stand and weather
departure_bridge: Compare same-date EHAM arrival tails and missing-ID/long-gap departure rates descriptively. They are different populations; no 2026 departure labels are available, so arrival results cannot prove departure-label drift or quantify the leaderboard gap.
uncertainty: Day-cluster bootstrap for monthly tail-rate differences and common-cell estimates, with three-day blocks as sensitivity. Exact sparse counts and top-day concentration accompany estimates. No claims of independent confirmation from reused development data.
execution: Use local data and caches only. No competition prediction model fits, uploads, validation-weight changes or new external downloads are planned. Retain row-level outputs under ignored tmp/.
